page_note: Page is overwhelmingly substrate cosmological teaching, despite ~97% damage. First unit (segs 0-12) maps body parts of a cosmic figure onto cosmic domains: heart→men, liver→cattle, shoulder→birds, loins→fish, etc. — pure correspondence within the system. Second/third units (segs 13-33) enumerate cosmic figures and their functions: Living Spirit, Ambassador, Five Watchers (Unsleeping Ones), Holder/Mind/κάτοχος, King of Honor in seventh firmament, Palamas, King of Glory, Omophoros. All substrate. No editorial seams detected; no hortatory/ecclesial/polemic vocabulary present. The "sinner" mention in seg 16 is internal to the cosmic system. Heavy lacunae preserved with {N} markers.
